invariant_description: Canonical identity is nonblank and unique at each declared grain.
scientific_reason: Ambiguous identity makes temporal and review joins non-auditable.
expected_condition: frame/object, actor trajectory and unit keys are nonblank and unique where required
failure_condition: blank or duplicated canonical key

invariant_description: Review decisions join only by exact stable keys.
scientific_reason: Row positions change under rebuilds and can apply a decision to the wrong animal.
expected_condition: positional_matches equals zero
failure_condition: any positional or ordinal-only decision match

invariant_description: No temporal pair crosses temporal_unit_key at native grain.
scientific_reason: Cross-unit differencing invents motion outside the evidence support.
expected_condition: both pair endpoints share temporal_unit_key
failure_condition: pair endpoints have different temporal_unit_key

invariant_description: The first observation of every temporal unit has no valid inherited pair.
scientific_reason: Native review evidence must have exact source-unit support.
expected_condition: first pair mask is false in every temporal_unit_key
failure_condition: first row inherits motion, ROI or social delta

invariant_description: Timestamp is strictly increasing for a valid pair.
scientific_reason: Rates are undefined for nonpositive elapsed time.
expected_condition: delta_t greater than zero for every valid pair
failure_condition: valid pair with nonfinite or nonpositive delta_t

invariant_description: Invalid pairs contribute neither values nor denominator mass.
scientific_reason: Zero placeholders bias means, standard deviations, energy and activity ratios.
expected_condition: aggregates index only valid pair mask
failure_condition: invalid pair enters value set or denominator

invariant_description: Pair counts, ratio, observed frames and coverage are exported separately.
scientific_reason: A numerical zero cannot communicate evidence support.
expected_condition: valid_pair_count, possible_pair_count, valid_pair_ratio, observed_frame_count and motion_feature_coverage exist
failure_condition: any coverage field or availability mask missing

invariant_description: Producer, exporter, sidecar, loader and model names and order equal the five-group authoritative schema.
scientific_reason: Feature-order drift changes tensor meaning without changing shape.
expected_condition: actual ordered names equal expected ordered names
failure_condition: missing, reordered, duplicated or unexpected feature

invariant_description: Tensor feature dimension is fixed by schema version and hash.
scientific_reason: Variable dimensions make checkpoints and comparisons semantically incompatible.
expected_condition: actual dimension equals schema dimension
failure_condition: dimension differs or schema hash absent

invariant_description: Column availability cannot alter model feature selection.
scientific_reason: Silent shrinkage creates undetected semantic and shape drift.
expected_condition: all required columns present before export
failure_condition: availability-filtered feature list or missing column accepted

invariant_description: Equal-distance neighbors use stable canonical identity ordering.
scientific_reason: Scientific output cannot depend on dataframe row order.
expected_condition: distance, object_track_key, track_id, object_id order
failure_condition: tie resolved by input position or pig_id alone

invariant_description: Permutation of equivalent input rows yields identical key-sorted output.
scientific_reason: Row order is not scientific evidence.
expected_condition: semantic output digest identical after permutation
failure_condition: neighbor, pair or aggregate differs after row permutation

invariant_description: Temporal partner continuity uses canonical stable partner key.
scientific_reason: pig_id may be blank, duplicated or local to one annotation/video.
expected_condition: partner comparison uses object_track_key then track/object identity
failure_condition: pig_id is sole continuity identity

invariant_description: Target ROI contact ratio divides by ROI-available frames only.
scientific_reason: Unavailable ROI frames are not observed non-contact.
expected_condition: contact_and_available_count divided by available_count with separate mask
failure_condition: all frames used as denominator or zero availability treated as measured zero

invariant_description: Review-only and audit-only fields cannot enter model X.
scientific_reason: Review fields are unavailable at inference and can leak supervision.
expected_condition: explicit whitelist excludes review/manual/audit fields
failure_condition: review-only feature appears in tensor schema

invariant_description: Behavior-selected target_roi fields are model-forbidden.
scientific_reason: Selecting an ROI by the target label leaks label semantics.
expected_condition: only all-class label-independent ROI tensors enter X
failure_condition: target_roi or roi_target field selected

invariant_description: Recording date, session, video and overlapping units stay in one split role.
scientific_reason: Shared scene/session context creates optimistic leakage.
expected_condition: zero group overlap between train and held-out roles
failure_condition: any recording/session/video/native-unit overlap

invariant_description: No random frame/window split crosses source groups.
scientific_reason: Near-duplicate temporal observations invalidate independent evaluation.
expected_condition: splits assigned at declared grouped authority
failure_condition: frame-level random assignment

invariant_description: Row/key population is preserved where the stage is declared row-preserving.
scientific_reason: Silent row loss changes class and missingness distributions.
expected_condition: input and output row/key counts and identity hashes match
failure_condition: unexplained row/key loss, gain or reorder

invariant_description: Every downstream authority records code, input, schema and artifact hashes.
scientific_reason: Unhashed artifacts cannot be reproduced or invalidated reliably.
expected_condition: all authority hashes nonblank and verified
failure_condition: missing or mismatched authority hash

invariant_description: Formula, unit, mask, order or semantic version changes invalidate downstream artifacts.
scientific_reason: Old bytes are not evidence for new semantics.
expected_condition: new semantic/schema hash forces rebuild from earliest changed stage
failure_condition: downstream artifact reused across semantic hash change

invariant_description: Every declared stage has unique dependencies and one deterministic acyclic topological position.
scientific_reason: Invalid or incomplete dependency closure can preserve stale downstream authority.
expected_condition: 17 exact contract stages form a complete DAG
failure_condition: unknown dependency, cycle, duplicate stage or missing producer

invariant_description: Every stage code hash covers the complete transitive local runtime dependency closure of its mapped production entry points.
scientific_reason: Unhashed runtime production code can change artifact semantics without changing the stage execution fingerprint.
expected_condition: all resolved local runtime dependencies are explicit stage code authority and unresolved local dynamic imports are absent
failure_condition: missing entry point, production file, mapped dependency, or unresolved local dynamic import

invariant_description: Human decisions carry forward only by exact stable key and identical visual, identity and schema authority.
scientific_reason: Changed review evidence requires human revalidation and must never be joined positionally.
expected_condition: exact key and all required authorities identical
failure_condition: position, row, time or pig_id-only match, or changed visual authority

invariant_description: Missing, stale, diagnostic, audit-only or unsigned prerequisites authorize no official execution.
scientific_reason: Implementation evidence alone cannot authorize rebuild, GUI, export or training.
expected_condition: all authorization fields false until explicit signed authority
failure_condition: authorization true with invalid prerequisite or absent Phase 4 signoff

invariant_description: Validated artifact bytes move atomically and the matching manifest is promoted last.
scientific_reason: Partial outputs or manifests cannot become scientific authority.
expected_condition: validated output and manifest both exist with matching hashes
failure_condition: partial promotion, output without manifest, or hash mismatch

invariant_description: Native output and audit carry grain, pair scope, evidence semantics and motion schema versions.
scientific_reason: Unversioned semantics cannot be reproduced or invalidated.
expected_condition: all four provenance fields are present, constant and consistent
failure_condition: field missing, blank or inconsistent between output and audit

invariant_description: d(speed)/dt is tangential acceleration and vector magnitude derives from ax and ay.
scientific_reason: Constant-speed turning has nonzero vector acceleration.
expected_condition: names, formulas, masks and schema keep tangential and vector semantics distinct
failure_condition: d(speed)/dt called general magnitude or vector components absent

invariant_description: Every image distance declares exact metric/version and threshold calibration binding.
scientific_reason: Axis normalization and diagonal normalization differ on non-square images.
expected_condition: metric version explicit, physical claim false and thresholds unchanged without recalibration
failure_condition: ambiguous normalized distance, physical label or threshold migration
